LoanApplication.title: LoanApplication
LoanApplication.description: Represents a single loan application submitted by a user.

loanType.description: The type of loan requested (e.g., personal, property).

loanAmount.description: The current loan amount requested by the user.

loanStatus.description: The status of the loan (approved, rejected).

loanReason.description: The AI rationale for the loan status.

propertyValue.description: The value of the property for a property loan.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the application was created.

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The unique ID of the loan application.
